title: CEA-LIST at CheckThat! 2025: Evaluating LLMs as Detectors of Bias and Opinion in Text

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in detecting subjective, opinionated, or biased language in text by classifying sentences as either objective or subjective. The methodology compares various prompt engineering techniques, few-shot learning configurations, and multi-agent debate setups on a multilingual news dataset.
